description:
Imager Tuning (https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.motorola.imagertuning_athene)
Naming convention: imagertuning_[PHONE CODENAME]
This is the custom camera image processing stack on Motorola devices. It's generally important for improving image quality.
Playstore reviews indicate that it slows down the camera app significantly for some users (probably a bug).
